description.from:
New per-environment stacks (mirror thin-turn naming): ChatticusWeb, ChatticusWebStaging, ChatticusWebProduction — or one stack with environment context.

Pattern: S3 bucket (private) + CloudFront origin access control + distribution. Build output from web/ (static export or OpenNext/Lambda@Edge if SSR is required — decide when scaffolding the app).

Publish SSM parameters: /chatticus/{environment}/web/cloudfront-url and site-url.

Forbidden: Amplify, ALB, cdk deploy --all.
description.to:
Per-environment stacks (ChatticusWeb, ChatticusWebStaging, ChatticusWebProduction): S3 (private) + CloudFront with two behaviors.

Default: S3 origin for Next.js build output (static export unless SSR is required later).
/api/*: Lambda function URL origin imported from the matching thin-turn stack (caching disabled, SSE timeouts preserved). CloudFront Function strips /api prefix on viewer request.

Publish SSM: /chatticus/{environment}/web/site-url and cloudfront-url.

Rearchitect thin-turn stack: remove or demote the standalone viewer-facing CloudFront; export function URL and invoke-key wiring for the web stack to consume.

Forbidden: Amplify, ALB, cdk deploy --all.
